Note: afo_cc1frstx and afo_cc2frstx connect directly to the pad ring without being OR-ed together.
Be careful when using these alternate functions to control external transistors:
UCPD1_FRSTX1 is associated with CC1, while UCPD1_FRSTX2 is associated with CC2.
